answer: Your ex has to sign the sale documents like any co-owner, unless your divorce decree awards the car to you; in that case, bring a certified copy of the decree and your ex's signature isn't needed. Because your name changed, bring the document that shows the change, such as your divorce decree, and sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at the appointment. If your ex does need to sign but can't attend, they can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2 electronically with no notary, except in Georgia, where it must be notarized. If the names on the title are joined by 'or' rather than 'and', only one owner needs to sign.
